calculate_iou_between_boxes: calculate the intersection over union score for two bounding boxes given their coordinates
check_bbox_intersection: check if two bounding boxes described in pixel convention intersect with each other
rotate_pixel_coords: rotate a pixel coordinate counterclockwise by a given angle in radians around an origin point
label_image_with_text: label an image with custom text at a specified position using OpenCV putText
rotate_image_90_degrees: rotate an image in multiples of 90 degrees counterclockwise and return a contiguous array
